description: ASSUMED, 2026-09-13. No canonical coop.lexicon.* source exists yet (Lucian has not normalized the namespace) — this is a reconstruction of the shape `apps/appview/src/lib/events.ts` actually writes (see `apps/appview/src/lexicons/coop.ts`), so that this lexicon can validate our own output rather than invent requirements our code does not meet. KNOWN DIVERGENCE from `docs/research/context/2026-09-12_regenos-building-blocks-handoff.md` (read from `technefoundation/regenOS@c3e34d4`, also not canonical): that note describes an `attendance` field with values `open` | `approval`, plus `maxAttendees` and `waitlist` — our code has neither name; it writes a boolean `rsvpRequired` and an integer `capacity` instead, with no `waitlist` field at all (waitlisting is app-side, `lib/rsvp.ts#resolveGoingOrWaitlist`). `visibility`, `neighborhood`, `school` and `tags` below have no correspondence in the regenOS note at all. This is gap 7 in `docs/interop-audit.md`: ask Lucian whether `rsvpRequired`/`capacity` should be renamed to `attendance`/`maxAttendees`, or whether regenOS's shape is itself provisional.

main.description: Written alongside a community.lexicon.calendar.event by its host: the knobs the base lexicon has no room for.

event.description: Strong reference to the community.lexicon.calendar.event this configures.

timezone.description: IANA zone; matches freeschool.draft.series#timezone when the event is a series occurrence.

capacity.description: ASSUMED name. The regenOS handoff describes `maxAttendees` instead — unconfirmed which name (if either) Lucian's normalized lexicon will use.

visibility.description: ASSUMED, no regenOS correspondence found. 'listed' is the only value that reaches the public calendar (apps/appview/src/http/visibility.ts).

neighborhood.description: ASSUMED, no regenOS correspondence found. Coarse location shown to everyone for a `listed` event; the exact address is app-side (R9 tiered disclosure).

rsvpRequired.description: ASSUMED name. The regenOS handoff describes an `attendance` field with values `open` | `approval` instead — see the lexicon-level description for the divergence this needs resolving with Lucian.

school.description: ASSUMED, no regenOS correspondence found. DID of the school this event is offered under.

tags.description: ASSUMED, no regenOS correspondence found. Lowercase kebab tags; routes the school's own curation listing (lib/events.ts#routeListing).
